person_updates.identity_evidence: The page-77 George K. Chapman row was visually verified. Official NARA and CIA context, exact-name OSS searches, employment and occupation variants, obituary, newspaper, institutional, directory, and archival checks produced no defensible identity bridge. A California life-record candidate and older historical namesakes lacked an OSS, Box 118, or other corroborating identifier.
person_updates.next_action: Review the indexed personnel file in Box 118 for identity and pre-OSS affiliation evidence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified OSS index and official Army merged record share Harry E. Chapman's exact private identifier and compatible name. The Army record supplies the Jr. suffix and documents entry as a private on June 17, 1941 with the grouped civilian occupation Secretaries.
person_updates.next_action: Review the Box 118 personnel file to identify the employer, exact secretarial role, and Army-to-OSS sequence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The page-77 Horace L. Chapman row was visually verified. Official, CIA, exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, newspaper, institutional, directory, and archival checks found no Box 118 identity bridge. Prominent Ohio political and business results belonged to a nineteenth-century namesake and were rejected as chronologically incompatible.
person_updates.next_action: Review the indexed personnel file in Box 118 for identity and pre-OSS affiliation evidence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The page-77 Jack F. Chapman row was visually verified. Official NARA context, CIA Reading Room, exact-name OSS, employment, occupation, obituary, legal, institutional, newspaper, directory, and archival checks produced only modern or otherwise unbridged namesakes.
person_updates.next_action: Review the indexed personnel file in Box 118 for identity and pre-OSS affiliation evidence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified OSS index and official Army merged record share Jackie J. Chapman's exact full name and private identifier. The Army record documents entry as a private on January 27, 1943 with a grouped civilian occupation in aircraft building.
person_updates.next_action: Review the Box 118 personnel file to identify the aircraft employer, exact job, and Army-to-OSS sequence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified OSS index and official Army merged record share John P. Chapman's exact full name and private identifier. The Army record documents entry as a private on July 5, 1943 with the grouped civilian occupation Managers and officials, n.e.c. An official DPAA profile for a different same-name private has an incompatible wartime history and was rejected.
person_updates.next_action: Review the Box 118 personnel file to identify the employer, exact managerial role, and Army-to-OSS sequence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The page-77 Julia A. Chapman row and its private A-series identifier were visually verified. The identifier was absent from the incomplete official Army merged conversion; that absence is not negative proof and the prefix alone does not establish a personnel category. Official, CIA, exact-name OSS, employment, occupation, obituary, WAC, institutional, newspaper, and archival checks produced no direct identity bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review the indexed personnel file in Box 118; do not classify the record from the identifier prefix alone.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The page-77 Lois Chapman row was visually verified. Official NARA and CIA context, exact-name OSS searches, employment and occupation variants, obituary, newspaper, institutional, directory, and archival checks produced multiple common-name candidates but no corroborating OSS or Box 118 identity evidence.
person_updates.next_action: Review the indexed personnel file in Box 118 for identity and pre-OSS affiliation evidence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The page-77 Mae J. Chapman row was visually verified. Official, CIA, exact-name OSS, employment, occupation, obituary, newspaper, institutional, directory, and archival searches found no source that linked a same-name candidate to OSS or the Box 118 index record.
person_updates.next_action: Review the indexed personnel file in Box 118 for identity and pre-OSS affiliation evidence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified OSS index and official Army merged record share Revis R. Chapman's exact full name and private identifier. The Army record documents entry as a private on October 1, 1941. Its residual occupation value 999 is deliberately left uninterpreted.
person_updates.next_action: Review the Box 118 personnel file for an interpretable pre-Army occupation or employer and the Army-to-OSS sequence.
